vsm1.1:85.1: 27. For attention (manasi-kāra) as the means (upāya) and the way (patha) see M-a I 64.
vsm1.1:86.3: 28. Avadhi—"limit" = odhi: this form is not in PED (see M-a II 292).
vsm1.1:92.4: 29. "Child's flesh" (putta-maṃsa) is an allusion to the story (S II 98) of the couple who set out to cross a desert with an insufficient food supply but got to the other side by eating the flesh of their child who died on the way. The derivation given in PED, "A metaphor probably distorted from pūtamaṃsa," has no justification. The reference to rafts might be to D II 89.
